title: Transfection of Capsaspora owczarzaki using Calcium-Phosphate Precipitation
author: Helena Parra Acero
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p4adqse

steps.title: Seed and Grow Initial Culture
steps.instruction: Seed 10^7 cells in a flask with 5mL of growth medium and grow for 24h at 23ºC to achieve a confluent culture.

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Transfection
steps.instruction: Seed 2*10^6 cells per well from the confluent culture in 600 μL of growth medium.

steps.title: Pre-incubate with Transfection Medium
steps.instruction: Replace the growth medium with 600 μL of transfection medium and incubate for 30 min at 18ºC (room temperature).

steps.title: Prepare DNA Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a 300 μL DNA mix while cells are incubating in transfection medium.

substeps.instruction: Combine 1.271 pmol of plasmid in distilled water, adding water to reach a total volume of 120 μL.
Add 150 μL of 2X HBS to achieve a final concentration of 1X HBS.
Add 30 μL of 1.25 M CaCl2 dropwise while flickering the tube to obtain a final concentration of 125mM.
Invert the tube twice to ensure mixing.
Incubate the mix for 10 min at 37ºC.

steps.title: Apply DNA Mix
steps.instruction: Remove the medium and add 300 μL of the prepared DNA mix dropwise into the center of the wells.

steps.title: Post-Transfection Incubation
steps.instruction: Add 500 μL of transfection medium and incubate for at least 4h at 23ºC.

steps.title: Perform Osmotic Shock
steps.instruction: Remove the medium and perform an osmotic shock using 110 μL of 10% glycerol for 1 min.

steps.title: Recovery and Incubation
steps.instruction: Remove the glycerol and add 600 μL of growth medium.

steps.title: Screen for Transfected Cells
steps.instruction: If the plasmid contains a fluorescent marker, screen for positive cells 18h post transfection.

substeps.instruction: Use a fluorescent microscope or flow cytometry for screening.
